paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper searches for decaying DM via X-ray lines using eROSITA eFEDS data. Main results are model-independent DM decay rate limits (mass 1.8-18 keV), converted to sterile neutrino mixing angle and ALP photon coupling g_agamma. The ALP limit (figure 7) is shown in g_agamma [GeV^-1] vs ma [keV] using Caggamma=0.75 (DFSZ). Local DM density rho_sun=0.4 GeV/cm^3 (NFW). Numerical data points are approximate reads from figure 7 (axis range ~1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1); no data table provided. ALP limit best below 5 keV. Confidence lowered due to approximate plot-read values and multiple couplings (also sterile neutrino) presented.
